sections.title: Get all suffixes
sections.text:
GET /v1/suffixes

Get all DNS suffixes in the cluster.

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/suffixes 


#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
The response body contains a JSON array with all suffixes, represented as [suffix objects](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/suffix).
